segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin (oily T-zone, dry/sensitive elsewhere) reacted badly, developing body-wide dryness and itchy bumps despite applying only to the oily areas.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report it as gentle, calming, and compatible with tretinoin or vitamin C, while one reviewer had a systemic allergic-type reaction (dryness, itching, bumps) attributed to azelaic acid.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, textured skin found it smoothed texture and reduced dryness rather than worsening it.

concerns.aging: One reviewer credits it with defending skin against wrinkles and improving surface texture, though this is a single, general claim without detail.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports it helped dry texture and reduced dryness on her face, but a different reviewer experienced severe dryness and itching over her whole body after use, linked to an azelaic acid reaction.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report visible redness reduction, including for rosacea flare-ups and general redness, with effects noticed within days for some.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes it as soothing and non-irritating for her skin, and pairing well with tretinoin/vitamin C without added sensitivity, though another reviewer suspects it triggered a body-wide allergic reaction.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports it helps fade dark spots and even out skin tone, though improvement is gradual rather than immediate.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-focused reviewers report clearer skin, fewer and milder breakouts, or acne fully resolving; however, three reviewers saw no real improvement in acne (one noting it only refined pores, another finding it too mild, another still struggling with jawline acne).

aspects.libelle: Layers well under moisturizer or sunscreen
Compatible with tretinoin and vitamin C

extraits.texte: I have very distinct combination skin (my forehead and nose are oily and very acne prone, but the rest of my face is very dry, sensitive, and allergy prone). I got this product and only applied it to my forehead and nose, and within a day or two my ENTIRE BODY was dry and itchy with small bumps, especially my face, but not where I applied it. I looked it up and according to the Mayo Clinic, this is a reaction that some people experience to azelaic acid. If you have not dealt with skin sensitivity or allergies in the past, I'm sure this product works great, but just a warning.
